The enhanced chat view uses these npm packages from assistant-ui:
  @assistant-ui/react 0.15.28
  @assistant-ui/react-markdown 0.14.21

Upstream: https://github.com/assistant-ui/assistant-ui
License: MIT (included in LICENSE)
Runtime reference: https://www.assistant-ui.com/docs/runtimes/custom/external-store

The application uses ExternalStoreRuntime, ThreadPrimitive, MessagePrimitive,
ComposerPrimitive and MarkdownTextPrimitive. The application owns the session
transport and maps its messages into the library; assistant-ui does not replace
the retrieval service, provider calls, tenant permissions or delivery recovery.
